sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
1. Cleanse the face thoroughly. 
2. Apply a coin-sized amount of Glutathione Serum all over your face and neck. 
3. Use short but firm strokes to apply the serum. 
4. Do not stretch, pull or rub the skin.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Some serums hydrate. Some brighten. Very few do both while improving how your skin actually feels day to day. ✨
The Glutathione 3D Glow Skin Serum is designed as a multi-layer skin upgrade—working beyond just surface glow.

Think of it as a serum that handles three key concerns at once: hydration, uneven tone, and texture. The formula is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and sits comfortably under other products, making it easy to use morning or night. 💧

Glutathione helps support a brighter, more even look over time, while Hyaluronic Acid and Glycerin keep your skin hydrated and smooth. Vitamin E and B5 maintain skin health, and Retinoids work on refining texture and improving overall clarity. Ingredients like Mulberry Extract and Zinc support a more balanced and fresh appearance.

Why People Love It 😍

-> 3-in-1 Skin Approach – Works on glow, texture, and hydration together-> Everyday Lightweight Serum – No heaviness, no stickiness-> Tone Correction Support – Helps improve uneven-looking skin-> Smooth Skin Feel – Supports softer and refined texture-> Routine Friendly – Easy to layer with creams and sunscreen

Over time, your skin doesn’t just look better—it starts to feel more even, smoother, and easier to manage.

Your journey to luminosity starts here. ✨

NOTE:- People with sensitive skin are advised to perform a patch test. If a rash, redness, or itching appears, stop using it.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Can I use this serum every day?

Yes, it’s designed for daily use. You can apply it once or twice a day depending on your routine.

2. When should I apply this serum?

Use it after cleansing and before your moisturizer. It works well in both morning and night routines.

3. Is it suitable for oily or acne-prone skin?

Yes, the lightweight formula absorbs quickly and doesn’t feel heavy, making it suitable for oily and combination skin.

4. Will it make my skin oily or sticky?

No, it has a non-sticky texture that feels light and breathable on the skin.

5. How long does it take to see results?

With regular use, you may start noticing smoother and more even-looking skin over a few weeks.

6. Can I use it with other skincare products?

Yes, it layers easily with moisturizers, sunscreens, and other serums.

7. Is it safe for sensitive skin?

It is generally suitable, but if you have sensitive skin, a patch test is recommended before full use.

8. Can men use this serum?

Absolutely. It is suitable for anyone looking to improve skin tone, texture, and hydration.
